# 🌊 AquaVision AI — Deep Learning Underwater Image Enhancement & Marine Scene Analysis System

A comprehensive AI platform for optical underwater restoration, subsea video anti-flicker enhancement, marine biological species detection (YOLOv8), coral reef bleaching assessment, and automated engineering inspection reports.

--- ## 📌 Table of Contents 1. [Executive Overview](#-executive-overview) 2. [Key Capabilities & Innovations](#-key-capabilities--innovations) 3. [Optical Physics Degradation Model](#-optical-physics-degradation-model) 4. [Multi-Dataset Inventory](#-multi-dataset-inventory) 5. [Model Architecture & Checkpoints](#-model-architecture--checkpoints) 6. [System Architecture](#-system-architecture) 7. [Installation & Quickstart](#-installation--quickstart) - [Hardware & Software Prerequisites](#prerequisites) - [Backend Setup (FastAPI & PyTorch)](#1-backend-setup) - [Frontend Setup (Next.js & React)](#2-frontend-setup) 8. [Usage Guide](#-usage-guide) 9. [API Reference](#-api-reference) 10. [Scientific Evaluation Metrology](#-scientific-evaluation-metrology) 11. [Academic Attribution & Team](#-academic-attribution--team) --- ## 🔍 Executive Overview Light propagating through underwater environments undergoes severe exponential wavelength attenuation and scattering: - **Red Wavelength Absorption**: Red light (650–700 nm) is completely absorbed within 3–5 meters of depth, leading to strong greenish-cyan color casts. - **Forward & Backward Scattering**: Floating organic particles ("marine snow") scatter ambient illumination into random angles, reducing contrast and producing veiling glare. **AquaVision AI** resolves these optical degradations through a hybrid computer vision and deep learning platform featuring: - **AquaVisionNet**: Residual Attention U-Net with Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) channel recalibration. - **Guided Bilateral Upsampling**: Edge-preserving high-resolution processing (1080p/4K) without memory exhaustion. - **Marine Biological Intelligence**: Real-time YOLOv8 taxonomy bounding boxes and CIELAB coral bleaching health indexes. - **Subsea Video Pipeline**: Exponential Moving Average (EMA) anti-flicker temporal stabilization. - **Batch Survey & Reporting**: Automated multi-page PDF Marine Inspection Reports with faculty supervisor sign-off blocks. --- ## ✨ Key Capabilities & Innovations - **🚀 Deep Learning Optical Restoration**: Residual Attention U-Net trained on 19,000+ real and synthesized marine image pairs. - **🛡️ Zero-Downtime Classical Fallback**: Gray-World White Balance + CLAHE in LAB space for instant execution if GPU/weights are absent. - **🎯 YOLOv8 Marine Bio-Intelligence**: Automated detection and classification of marine fauna (fish, turtles, sharks), corals, divers, and marine debris with high-tech HUD overlays. - **🪸 Coral Reef Bleaching Metrology**: CIELAB/HSV colorimetric analysis computing Bleaching Index (0.0 to 1.0), benthic coverage, algal overgrowth, and scientific survey advisories. - **🎬 Subsea Video Anti-Flicker Processing**: Temporal EMA smoothing ($I_t' = (1-\alpha)\hat{I}_t + \alpha I_{t-1}'$) that eliminates frame flickering in underwater video streams. - **📦 Batch Survey & ZIP Packaging**: Drag-and-drop batch queue, processing telemetry, and one-click ZIP exports containing enhanced images, annotated HUD frames, and JSON metadata. - **📄 Official Marine Inspection PDF Reports**: Automated ReportLab PDF generator containing side-by-side photographic evidence, quantitative metrics tables, and formal engineering verification blocks. - **📊 Quantitative Benchmark Suite**: Automated evaluation across UIEB, LSUI, and EUVP with real-time UI charts, CSV exports, and publication-ready LaTeX tables. - **🔄 Dynamic Checkpoint Switcher**: Live switching between specialized checkpoints (`model.pth`, `model_lsui.pth`, `model_euvp.pth`, `model_combined.pth`). --- ## 🌊 Optical Physics Degradation Model Underwater image formation follows the Jaffe-McGlamery optical model: $$E(x, \lambda) = J(x, \lambda) \cdot t(x, \lambda) + B_\infty(\lambda) \cdot (1 - t(x, \lambda))$$ Where: - $J(x, \lambda)$ represents the true, unattenuated scene radiance. - $t(x, \lambda) = e^{-\beta(\lambda) d(x)}$ represents the wavelength-dependent transmission map across distance $d(x)$. - $B_\infty(\lambda)$ is the background veiling waterlight. - $\beta(\lambda) = a(\lambda) + b(\lambda)$ is the total attenuation coefficient (absorption + scattering). AquaVisionNet learns to invert this non-linear function by dynamically recalibrating color channels and restoring structural contrast. --- ## 📊 Multi-Dataset Inventory AquaVision supports multi-dataset training and evaluation across 19,019 underwater image pairs: | Dataset | Image Pairs | Domain & Environmental Scope | Output Weights | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **UIEB** | 800 Train / 90 Val | Diverse coastal and blue deep-sea waters with volunteer ground truths | `weights/model.pth` | | **LSUI** | 3,851 Train / 428 Val | Turbid, green-tinted, benthic coral reef ecosystems | `weights/model_lsui.pth` | | **EUVP** | 12,465 Train / 1,385 Val | ROV abyssal explorations, dark waters, ImageNet underwater subsets | `weights/model_euvp.pth` | | **AquaVision-Unified** | **19,019 Combined Pairs** | All marine water types and lighting conditions | `weights/model_combined.pth` | *Note: All raw/ground-truth dataset images in `backend/dataset/` are excluded from Git via `.gitignore`.* --- ## 🧠 Model Architecture & Checkpoints ### 1. AquaVisionNet Architecture - **Input / Output**: $256 \times 256 \times 3$ RGB tensor normalized to $[-1, 1]$. - **Encoder**: 4 downsampling stages with Residual blocks and **Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE)** modules that reweight channel contributions based on global receptive fields. - **Bottleneck**: Deep residual attention blocks capturing multi-scale context. - **Decoder**: 4 upsampling stages with skip connections restoring spatial edge details and high-frequency textures. - **Loss Function**: Hybrid combination of $L_1$ pixel loss, Mean Squared Error (MSE), and Structural Similarity (SSIM): $$\mathcal{L}_{\text{total}} = 0.5 \cdot \mathcal{L}_{1} + 0.2 \cdot \mathcal{L}_{\text{MSE}} + 0.3 \cdot (1 - \text{SSIM})$$ ### 2. Guided Bilateral Upsampling (High-Resolution Pipeline) To process 1080p and 4K images on hardware with 4 GB VRAM: 1. Low-resolution tensor ($256 \times 256$) is enhanced via AquaVisionNet. 2. Color chrominance channels are upscaled via Lanczos-4 interpolation. 3. Luminance channel is refined by fusing high-pass structural edge gradients extracted from the original high-resolution input, eliminating interpolation ringing. --- ## 🏗️ System Architecture ``` ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ Next.js 16 Client (React & Tailwind) │ │ [Single Image] | [Subsea Video (EMA)] | [Batch Survey Processing] │ │ - Split Slider Viewer - Anti-Flicker GPU - ZIP Archive │ │ - Biological HUD Toggle - Side-by-Side Video - Survey PDF │ │ - Checkpoint Switcher - Benchmark Modal - System Specs │ └───────────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────┘ │ HTTP Multipart / JSON REST ▼ ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ FastAPI Backend Server │ │ (/upload, /video, /batch, /batch/zip, /batch/report, /models, /detect) │ └─────────────────┬───────────────────┬───────────────────┬──────────────┘ │ │ │ ▼ ▼ ▼ ┌──────────────────┐ ┌──────────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐ │ AquaVisionNet │ │ YOLOv8 Marine │ │ ReportLab │ │ Residual Attention│ │ Detector & Coral│ │ Inspection │ │ U-Net (PyTorch) │ │ Health Analyzer │ │ PDF Generator│ └──────────────────┘ └──────────────────┘ └──────────────┘ ``` --- ## 🚀 Installation & Quickstart ### Prerequisites - **Operating System**: Windows 10/11, Ubuntu 20.04+, or macOS - **Python**: 3.10+ (Recommended: PyTorch 2.6 with CUDA support) - **Node.js**: 18.0+ & **npm** - **GPU (Optional)**: NVIDIA GPU with CUDA 12+ (e.g., NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU, 4 GB VRAM) --- ### 1. Backend Setup ```bash # 1. Clone the repository git clone https://github.com/Piyush851/AquaVision.git cd AquaVision/backend # 2. Create and activate virtual environment python -m venv venv # Windows: venv\Scripts\activate # Linux/macOS: source venv/bin/activate # 3. Install dependencies pip install -r requirements.txt # 4. Start the FastAPI server python app/main.py ``` Backend runs at **`http://localhost:8000`** (Swagger docs: `http://localhost:8000/docs`). --- ### 2. Frontend Setup ```bash # 1. Navigate to frontend directory cd ../frontend # 2. Install dependencies npm install # 3. Start development server npm run dev ``` Open **`http://localhost:3000`** in your browser. --- ## 💻 Usage Guide ### 1. Single Image Restoration - Upload any underwater photograph or click one of the 4 benchmark presets. - Drag the **split-screen slider** to inspect before/after color restoration and contrast recovery. - Click **"Biological Overlay"** to view real-time YOLOv8 bounding boxes and coral reef health tags. - Click **"Generate PDF Report"** to download an engineering inspection report. ### 2. Subsea Video Enhancement - Select the **"Subsea Video Enhancement"** tab. - Drag and drop a subsea video file (`.mp4`, `.mov`, `.avi`, `.webm` up to 50 MB). - Toggle side-by-side composite mode and click **"Enhance Subsea Video"**. ### 3. Batch Survey Processing - Select the **"Batch Survey Processing"** tab. - Drop multiple images or click **"+ Load 4 Benchmark Samples"**. - Click **"Run Batch Pipeline"**. - View aggregate statistics (mean PSNR gain, UIQM, organism count) and download a single **ZIP Archive** or **Official Survey PDF**. ### 4. Dynamic Model Switching - Click the **"Model"** button in the navigation header. - Switch between `model_combined.pth` (Unified), `model_lsui.pth` (Turbid reefs), `model_euvp.pth` (Abyssal), and `model.pth` (UIEB). --- ## 🔌 API Reference | Endpoint | Method | Description | | :--- | :---: | :--- | | `/api/v1/enhance/upload` | `POST` | Upload and enhance single image (`multipart/form-data`) | | `/api/v1/enhance/detect/{file_id}` | `POST` | Run YOLOv8 marine detection & coral bleaching analysis | | `/api/v1/enhance/report/{file_id}` | `POST` | Generate individual formal engineering PDF report | | `/api/v1/enhance/video` | `POST` | Process subsea video with temporal anti-flicker EMA | | `/api/v1/enhance/batch` | `POST` | Batch process multiple frames with metrics & biological detection | | `/api/v1/enhance/batch/zip` | `POST` | Download structured ZIP package (enhanced, HUD, metadata JSON) | | `/api/v1/enhance/batch/report` | `POST` | Generate official multi-page Marine Survey PDF report | | `/api/v1/enhance/models` | `GET` | List available model checkpoints and active weights | | `/api/v1/enhance/switch-model` | `POST` | Hot-swap active neural network checkpoint | | `/api/v1/enhance/benchmark` | `GET` | Retrieve quantitative benchmark metrology results | | `/api/v1/enhance/benchmark/export/csv` | `GET` | Export benchmark comparison matrix as CSV | | `/api/v1/enhance/benchmark/export/latex`| `GET` | Export publication-ready LaTeX table | --- ## 📈 Scientific Evaluation Metrology AquaVision employs both full-reference and no-reference optical quality metrics: 1. **PSNR (Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio)**: $$\text{PSNR} = 10 \cdot \log_{10}\left(\frac{\text{MAX}_I^2}{\text{MSE}}\right)$$ 2. **SSIM (Structural Similarity Index)**: Evaluates luminance, contrast, and structural preservation. 3. **UIQM (Underwater Image Quality Measure)**: $$\text{UIQM} = c_1 \cdot \text{UICM} + c_2 \cdot \text{UISM} + c_3 \cdot \text{UIConM}$$ *(UICM: Colorfulness, UISM: Sharpness, UIConM: Contrast)* 4. **UCIQE (Underwater Color Image Quality Evaluation)**: $$\text{UCIQE} = c_1 \cdot \sigma_c + c_2 \cdot \text{con}_l + c_3 \cdot \mu_s$$ *(Chroma standard deviation, luminance contrast, saturation mean)* --- ##
